tooltip.ragecraft4reforged.mechanics_wik: Essential information about the Runeforge, magic items, and effects
gui.ragecraft4reforged.mechanics_wiki.pa: %s / %s
Essential Information
This is the Runeforge, an ancient and powerful tool that allows you to craft magic items.
Forget everything you know! If you want to survive in the underworld, you must master the Runeforge.
You can use runes to turn basic items into magical ones. Each item can have no more than one prefix, one suffix, and one upgrade.
Using the Compendium
Choose a chapter from the contents on the left.
Use the arrow buttons to change pages and the mouse wheel to scroll long text.
Press Escape to close the book. The book does not pause the game.
Runeforging Basics
You can modify compatible swords, axes, bows, pickaxes, and armor. Reforged also accepts compatible modded equipment.
You can modify items as long as they are missing either a prefix, suffix, or upgrade. Items that have all three of these can no longer be modified.
Runes are NOT consumed when you craft an item. You can use the same rune over and over again as long as you have enough crafting currency.
The crafting cost (lapis and/or amethyst shards) is displayed in the Runeforge interface. When you press the button, the crafting material is removed from your inventory.
Repairing

The prose calls the experience cost “levels,” but the original script actually removes repair_cost×10 XP points; Reforged follows the script. Every lapis or amethyst spent while forging is added to repair_cost.

Material amounts: chestplates 4, leggings 3, helmets/boots 2, and swords/axes/pickaxes 3. The material is leather, chain, cobblestone, iron, diamond, or netherite. Bows, crossbows, shields, and items without a mapped material cost XP only.
Workbench Slots
Place the base item in the middle of the Runeforge. Then place prefix, suffix, and upgrade runes in their corresponding slots.
Each item can have no more than one prefix, one suffix, and one upgrade. Place the appropriate runes, then press the button to complete the crafting!
You can add modifiers one by one, or all at once.
The rarity of a rune or item has no effect other than color and "flavor".
Prefix Runes
Each item can have no more than one prefix, one suffix, and one upgrade.
Place a sword, axe, archery, mining, or armor sigil in the prefix slot, then choose a compatible prefix.
You can add modifiers one by one, or all at once.
Runes are NOT consumed when you craft an item. You can use the same rune over and over again.
Upgrade Runes
This rune sure looks odd. Maybe it will fit into that mysterious top slot of the Runeforge?
Each item can have no more than one prefix, one suffix, and one upgrade.
Items that have all three of these can no longer be modified.
This item appears to be imbued with some unusual powers. I wonder what happens if I add another enchantment to it at the Runeforge?

Upgrade runes occur in natural reward chests: low runes requiring Rune Power 1 have a 20% chance in ordinary exploration chests; mid runes requiring Power 3–4 have a 15% chance in strongholds, Nether fortresses, and woodland mansions; high runes requiring Power 5–7 have a 10% chance in bastion treasure, ancient city, and End city chests.
Suffix Runes
Each item can have no more than one prefix, one suffix, and one upgrade.
Place an Arcane, Blood, Chaos, Fire, Holy, Ice, Lightning, or Poison sigil in the suffix slot, then choose a compatible suffix.
You can add modifiers one by one, or all at once.
Runes are NOT consumed when you craft an item. You can use the same rune over and over again.

Craft a school sigil with one lapis lazuli, one amethyst shard, and one themed item: book (Arcane), rotten flesh (Blood), gunpowder (Chaos), coal (Fire), gold nugget (Holy), snowball (Ice), copper ingot (Lightning), or spider eye (Poison).

Suffix attacks and area effects can affect every non-player living creature, including passive, tamed, and modded creatures. Targets marked as spell-immune still follow their corresponding immunity rules.
Rune Power
Some runes require so-called Rune Power. Increasing it enables you to use more powerful runes at the Runeforge.
Crafting requires rare materials such as Lapis Lazuli. Some powerful runes can only be used if you possess a certain amount of Rune Power.
Reforged: press the unlock button and spend one emerald block to gain +1 Rune Power.
Rune Power is permanent, has a maximum of 12, and survives death.
Wands and Scepters
All spells share a cooldown of 20 s.
Searing Wand — Right-click to shoot a fireball that explodes on impact, dealing 14 damage to enemies and setting them on fire. Gain 2 mana for each affected enemy.
Arctic Wand — Right-click to shoot a projectile that explodes on impact, dealing 10 damage and afflicting enemies with 15 s of Slowness II. Gain 2 mana for each affected enemy.
Reaping Wand — Right-click to deal 8 damage to nearby enemies in front of you and afflict them with 12 s of Weakness I. Gain 3 s of Strength II per affected enemy (max: 12 s).

Direct hits, rays, and area effects from wands can affect every non-player living creature, including passive, tamed, and modded creatures. Targets marked as spell-immune still follow their corresponding immunity rules.
Crafting Wands
Every wand recipe uses exactly one Unenchanted Wand in the center. Acquiring one unlocks all directed wand recipes in the recipe book.
Lesser wands use common materials such as coal, torches, snowballs, bones, rotten flesh, and amethyst.
Powerful wands require rarer materials from the Nether, oceans, raids, ancient cities, and Wither Skeletons.
The Empowered Teleportation Wand is mid-tier. Only the Supreme version requires Netherite Scrap, End Crystals, and a Nether Star.
Accessories
Searing Totem — [Avatar of Fire] ALL enemies have Flammability II.
Void Stone — [Call of the Void] When you cast a spell, release three void spheres which seek out enemies, dealing 8 damage and applying 8 s of Wither I on impact.
When you throw an infinite splash potion, release one void sphere.
An accessory's original tooltip lists its ability, attributes, and any penalties.
Equip one accessory in the dedicated RC4 Accessory slot in the Curios inventory (default key: G). Its attributes and ability only work while equipped there.

Naturally generated exploration and treasure chests can contain one random accessory: 8% in ordinary exploration chests and 16% in high-value structure chests. Village profession and bonus chests are excluded.
Infinite Potions
🧪 Infinite Splash Potion 🧪
Throw the potion to activate the effect written in its original tooltip.
Instantly refills after 5 s. This cooldown increases if you use multiple infinite potions.
Some accessories add deadly shrapnel, obsidian shards, or void spheres to potion impacts.
Craft four Awkward Potions together to receive one random infinite potion or elixir.
Infinite Elixirs
Rock Ale — Drink to restore 2❤ and gain 15 s of Speed I.
Mana Elixir — Drink to restore 10 mana.
Metamorph Potion — Gain 20 s of Strength IV and Slowness II.
Concentrated Adrenaline — Gain 25 s of Speed II and Haste II. You have no natural mana regeneration for 25 s.
Melee Enchantments
Decapitate — Instantly kill ELITE enemies that have less than 16 + 8*lvl health left after your attack.
Life Leech — Gain 2*lvl seconds of Regeneration II on kill.
Mana Leech — Gain 1*lvl mana on kill.
Slam — Deal 2*lvl additional damage with critical strikes.
Ranged Enchantments
Sharpshot — Draw your bow for at least 2.5 s to gain 2*lvl additional power.
Trueshot — Your critical arrows are unaffected by gravity.
Volley — Your critical attacks fire 2*lvl additional arrows. Effects that cost mana only apply to the central arrow.
Intellect — Increases your mana regeneration by 25%*lvl.
Decay and Flammability
Decay — Affected enemies take (0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5) * lvl additional damage per second while afflicted with Wither I / II / III.
Flammability — Affected enemies take 1*lvl additional damage per second while on fire.
Vulnerability — Affected enemies take 50% more damage from all sources.
These are the original encyclopedia descriptions for RC4's three principal debuffs.
Vulnerability and Mana
Slice — Targets bleed for 8 s, losing 0.5 + 0.5*lvl life per second. Stacks with other DoT effects.
Mana Leech — Gain 1*lvl mana on kill.
Intellect — Increases your mana regeneration by 25%*lvl.
Volley — Effects that cost mana only apply to the central arrow.
